mapper.select: select count(*) from member where id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into member (id, pw, name, phone, email, zipcode, address1, address2) values (#{id}, #{pw}, #{name}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{zipcode}, #{address1}, #{address2})
mapper.update: update member set name = #{name}, phone = #{phone}, email = #{email}, zipcode = #{zipcode}, address1 = #{address1}, address2 = #{address2} where id = #{id}
